filling: Good morning, Mr. Lowe. I just wanted to quickly confirm that I'm here to help with the espresso preparation today. I'll be ready by 8 sharp, and I've already double-checked the fridge—oat milk is fresh and at the right temperature. I'll make sure to match the brew temperature exactly with Dolores, as we agreed, and we'll both try the new latte art pattern together. I’ll take a clear photo right after finishing and share it with you later as planned.

Good morning, Maeve. I see you're prepared, but remember—any deviation in temperature or pour consistency, and you're on your own. Dolores has hands that tremble when the water changes, so you must match her exact precision. If the oat milk isn't at 60 degrees, she’ll remake the latte art eight times. You understand? And don’t hesitate to ask if you’re unsure. If you take more than five seconds to respond, I’ll be forced to assume you’re not listening.

Yes, Mr. Lowe, I understand completely. I’ll make sure the oat milk is at exactly 60 degrees, match Dolores’s brew temperature precisely, and pay close attention to every detail—especially the pour consistency.
